questions.stem: What is the correct average harvest per tree if the initial average was 25.6 and one tree's count was 3 more than the actual?
questions.solution: The initial total harvest was 25.6 × 15 = 384. Since one tree's count was 3 more than actual, the correct total is 384 - 3 = 381. The correct average is 381 / 15 = 25.4. The option 25.6 is the incorrect initial average. The option 25.8 is the result of adding 3 instead of subtracting. The option 26.0 is a random guess.

hi.stem: यदि प्रारंभिक औसत 25.6 था और एक पेड़ की गिनती वास्तविक के 3 अधिक थी, तो पेड़ प्रति औसत उत्पादन सही क्या है?
hi.solution: प्रारंभिक कुल उत्पादन 25.6 × 15 = 384 था। चूंकि एक पेड़ की गिनती वास्तविक के 3 अधिक थी, सही कुल उत्पादन 384 - 3 = 381 है। सही औसत 381 / 15 = 25.4 है। विकल्प 25.6 गलत प्रारंभिक औसत है। विकल्प 25.8 तीन घटाने के बजाय जोड़ने के परिणाम है। विकल्प 26.0 एक अनुमान है।

mr.solution: सुरुवातीचे एकूण उत्पादन 25.6 × 15 = 384 होते. एका वृक्षाच्या गणनेत 3 अधिक असल्यामुळे, योग्य एकूण उत्पादन 384 - 3 = 381 होते. योग्य सरासरी 381 / 15 = 25.4 आहे. 25.6 हा अयोग्य सुरुवातीचा सरासरी आहे. 25.8 हा 3 जोडल्यामुळे मिळालेला निकाल आहे. 26.0 हा अनुमान आहे.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi technical terms for mathematical concepts.

questions.stem: What is the correct average height of the class if the students were wearing shoes that added 1 cm to their height?
questions.solution: The original average height was 150.2 cm, but since the shoes added 1 cm to each student's height, the correct average height would be 150.2 cm minus 1 cm, which is 149.2 cm. questions.stem: What is the main advantage of using a line graph over a column graph for showing data with many points?
choices: It is more colorful
It is easier to read when there are many points
It shows the exact values of each data point
It is always more accurate
questions.solution: The main advantage of a line graph over a column graph for showing data with many points is that it is easier to read when there are many points. A column graph with many columns can look cluttered, while a line graph provides a smooth and clear representation of the data. The other options are incorrect because they do not accurately describe the advantage of line graphs over column graphs.

questions.stem: The mean of 3 numbers is 12. If one of the numbers is 10, what is the average of the other two numbers?
questions.solution: The mean of 3 numbers is 12, so the total sum is 3 × 12 = 36. One of the numbers is 10, so the sum of the other two is 36 - 10 = 26. The average of the other two is 26 ÷ 2 = 13. Option A (12) assumes the average is the same as the original. Option C (14) adds 10 to 26. Option D (15) divides 26 by 2 incorrectly.

hi.stem: 3 संख्याओं का माध्य 12 है। यदि इनमें से एक संख्या 10 है, तो अन्य दो संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
hi.solution: 3 संख्याओं का माध्य 12 है, अतः कुल योग 3 × 12 = 36 है। इनमें से एक संख्या 10 है, अतः अन्य दो का योग 36 - 10 = 26 है। अन्य दो का औसत 26 ÷ 2 = 13 है। विकल्प A (12) मान लेता है कि औसत मूल माध्य के समान है। विकल्प C (14) 26 में 10 जोड़ देता है। विकल्प D (15) 26 को 2 से गलत तरीके से विभाजित कर देता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology common in Hindi textbooks.

mr.solution: 3 संख्यांचे सरासरी 12 आहे, म्हणून एकूण बेरीज 3 × 12 = 36 आहे. त्यापैकी एक संख्या 10 आहे, म्हणून उरलेल्या दोन संख्यांची बेरीज 36 - 10 = 26 आहे. उरलेल्या दोन संख्यांचे सरासरी 26 ÷ 2 = 13 आहे. विकल्प A (12) सरासरी मूळ सरासरीसारखी असल्याचा अंदाज घेतो. विकल्प C (14) 26 मध्ये 10 जोडतो. विकल्प D (15) 26 ला 2 ने भागल्याचा चुकीचा अंदाज घेतो.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is always true about the median of a data set?
choices: Removing a value less than the median will decrease the median.
Including a value less than the mean will decrease the mean.
Including any 4 values will not affect the median.
Including 4 values less than the median will increase the median.
questions.solution: Including 4 values less than the median will increase the median because it adds more lower values, which can shift the middle value of the data set upwards. The other options are not always true because removing a value less than the median may not always decrease the median, including a value less than the mean may not always decrease the mean, and including any 4 values may affect the median depending on the values added.
